description: Drafts a pre-order for a time slot, for PICKUP (default) or courier DELIVERY (method: delivery, with deliveryAddress or savedLocationId; the slot must offer delivery and the venue must deliver, and the delivery fee is paid to the rider on delivery). Nothing is placed or reserved: it checks the slot against the items (lead time, capacity, items sold that day), prices the order with choices, and returns the summary: slot and ready time, items, total, what is due now and what on collection. The slot comes from list_preorder_slots (slotInstanceId). Returns a draftId for place_preorder. Requires the connected WaitApp account. payment: on_collection (default; the guest pays the venue when collecting) or online (the amount due now is paid by the guest on WaitApp's payment page after the order is placed; the assistant sends and approves no payment); some venues require online. guestPhone is required: the guest and venue use it to find the order. One slot per order.

deliveryAddress.description: For delivery: the full address. Not needed when savedLocationId is given

guestName.description: Who collects, or receives, the order

savedLocationId.description: For delivery: one of the person's saved locations (see list_saved_locations)
